incident_text: A big fire is burning on this street tonight.

result.scene_summary: A quiet, dark street lined with traditional brick buildings at night, illuminated by street lamps and lights from windows.

observations.description: A row of multi-story brick buildings with white-framed windows and doors.
No vehicles visible in the image.
Flowering plants in window boxes on the buildings.
Traditional street lamps mounted on the buildings.
Lights shining from inside the windows of the buildings.
Dark street with no visible pedestrians or vehicles.
